player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Mwaka {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Mwaka Myoki - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lolenge ya kotia ezali malamu te. Kosalela: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Nkombo ya elanga ezalí na ndingisa te. Elanga oyo ezali malamu: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Ba allocations nyonso esengeli kozala ba integers oyo ezali ya négatif te.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Oza na kosambela makambo {num_total_units} kasi. Kizazi kya sika: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ekomama {score_0}-{score_1} ba ntango ya {num_rounds} mwaka!
outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta ekomama {score_1}-{score_0} ba ntango ya {num_rounds} mwaka!
outcome.draw: Mwaka ebongi na {score_0}-{score_1} ba ntango ya {num_rounds} mwaka!
